world.title: Strategic time-out: Hours after UAE crown prince departs, Saudi FM lands in Delhi for BRICS
world.summary: Saudi Foreign Minister arrived in Delhi for the BRICS Summit shortly after the UAE crown prince's departure. Despite differing views on Yemen and Sudan, and ongoing regional conflicts, both nations share membership in the Gulf Cooperation Council, Arab League, and Organisation of Islamic Cooperation. They maintain their status as US allies while participating in the summit amid internal divisions.

world.title: BRICS Summit 2026 LIVE: PM Modi holds bilateral talks on last day of summit; Oppn, BJP leaders spar over dinner menu
world.summary: On the second day of the BRICS Summit 2026, Prime Minister Modi focused on a four-pillar agenda addressing early-warning systems, disaster management, artificial intelligence, digital agriculture, supply chains, and startups. Additionally, there was a political exchange between opposition and BJP leaders regarding the dinner menu. The summit continues to emphasize collaboration among member nations on various global challenges.

world.title: 130 missing after Indonesian passenger ship sinks in Java Sea; 107 rescued, 6 dead - video
world.summary: Indonesian rescuers are searching the Java Sea for 130 individuals missing after the passenger ship Virgo Transport 8 sank due to bad weather. So far, 107 people have been rescued, while six bodies have been recovered. The incident has prompted intensified rescue efforts as authorities work to locate the remaining missing passengers from the overturned vessel.

business.title: This SUV Makes More Sense Bought Used Instead Of New
business.summary: A specific SUV is highlighted as a better purchase when bought used rather than new, combining solid construction, modern technology, and a reliable engine. The used car market is increasingly popular in India, where buyers seek luxury vehicles at mid-size SUV prices or spacious seven-seaters for the cost of compact SUVs, often overlooking valuable options.

business.title: IITian quits Salesforce job for Google, shares why: ‘I had to prove it to myself'
business.summary: A Bengaluru-based techie left his job at Salesforce to join Google, motivated by a personal challenge rather than dissatisfaction with his previous employer. He reflected on his early struggles with coding and technical discussions during his career at Samsung. His decision was rooted in a desire to validate his skills and prove his worth in the tech industry.

business.title: India’s semiconductor sector attracts $1.4 billion in funding across 281 companies
business.summary: India's semiconductor sector has secured $1.4 billion in cumulative equity funding across 281 companies. Nearly half of this amount was raised recently, with $701 million collected since 2025. The growth in funding reflects increasing interest and investment in the sector, highlighting its potential for development and innovation in the technology landscape.

technology.title: iOS 27 Monday: The Features That Turn on by Themselves, and the Ones That Do Not
technology.summary: iOS 27 will launch on Monday, with most features activating automatically upon installation. However, users will need to change a language setting for Siri AI to function properly. Additionally, two features announced by Apple in June will not be available at launch. Overall, the majority of iOS 27's enhancements require no configuration from users.

technology.title: OpenRGB reaches 1.0 after nearly three years of development
technology.summary: OpenRGB has officially launched version 1.0, marking its first stable update since 2023. This open-source RGB control tool, developed over nearly three years, introduces new hardware support and significant core changes. Additionally, the update enhances its SDK and Plugin API, allowing for improved functionality and compatibility with various hardware setups, further expanding its usability for users.

technology.title: New STARCRAFT game announced at BlizzCon 2026; Launching in 2030
technology.summary: Blizzard Entertainment announced a new StarCraft game during BlizzCon 2026, marking the franchise's return after nearly two decades. The upcoming title will be an open-world shooter, expanding the series into new gameplay territory. The game is scheduled for release in 2030, generating excitement among fans and players eager to explore this iconic universe once again.

sports.title: Cristiano Ronaldo demands action after Ruben Neves targeted by sick Diogo Jota chants
sports.summary: Cristiano Ronaldo has condemned fans who directed offensive chants about Diogo Jota at Ruben Neves during a recent match for Al-Hilal. The incident involved mocking Jota's death, prompting Ronaldo to demand action against such behavior. Neves, a former Wolverhampton Wanderers player, faced the disturbing chants while representing his Saudi club, highlighting the need for accountability in football.

sports.title: India vs West Indies ODIs: K L Rahul Likely Vice-Captain; Pant Vs Jurel For Keeper Slot
sports.summary: K L Rahul is expected to be appointed as India's vice-captain for the three-match ODI series against the West Indies, beginning on September 27. The selection for the wicketkeeper position is between Rishabh Pant and Sanju Samson Jurel, with the head coach and captain's opinions playing a crucial role in the final decision.

sports.title: Men's Junior Hockey Asia Cup: India wins third consecutive title after beating Korea in final
sports.summary: India secured its third consecutive Men’s Junior Hockey Asia Cup title by defeating South Korea 4-1 in the final held in Moqi, China. This victory marks a significant achievement for the Indian team, reinforcing their dominance in the tournament. The win coincided with the Indian women’s team also claiming their third straight title earlier in the day.

health.title: A Startling Percentage Of Americans Have Fatty Liver Disease - Here’s How Your Diet Can Prevent It
health.summary: An estimated 25% of U.S. adults have metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), also known as fatty liver disease, making it the most prevalent chronic liver condition. Alarmingly, less than 5% of those affected are aware of their diagnosis. Dietary changes can help prevent the disease, highlighting the importance of awareness and lifestyle modifications for better liver health.

health.title: HPV Vaccination drive: India crosses 80 lakh milestone under nationwide campaign
health.summary: India has successfully administered over 80 lakh human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccinations as part of its nationwide campaign. This achievement highlights the country's commitment to enhancing preventive healthcare measures and providing protection against HPV infections and related cancers. The initiative aims to increase awareness and accessibility of HPV vaccinations, contributing to improved public health outcomes across the nation.

health.title: Pakistan remains one of only two countries with endemic polio as vaccination gaps persist: Report
health.summary: Pakistan remains one of only two countries, alongside Afghanistan, where wild poliovirus transmission is endemic. A recent report highlights ongoing challenges in polio eradication efforts, citing persistent gaps in vaccination coverage and community resistance as significant factors putting children at risk. These issues continue to hinder progress towards eliminating polio in the country.

science.title: China’s FAST telescope creates largest neutral hydrogen catalog
science.summary: China’s FAST radio telescope in Guizhou Province has unveiled the second data set of the FASHI survey, which includes 156,411 extragalactic neutral hydrogen sources. This catalog is the largest of its kind beyond the Milky Way, marking a significant advancement in astronomical research. The findings aim to enhance understanding of the universe's structure and evolution.

science.title: AI BioDesign Advances Novel Biomolecule Design
science.summary: AI BioDesign integrates artificial intelligence with experimental validation to enhance biomolecule design for drug discovery. By leveraging open datasets, researchers aim to create innovative solutions based on nature's principles. This approach seeks to address challenges in life sciences, potentially leading to significant advancements in healthcare and therapeutic development, while fostering collaboration and knowledge sharing within the scientific community.

science.title: NASA And IBM Put 30 Lunar Data Layers Into One AI Map
science.summary: NASA and IBM have unveiled an open-source Lunar Foundation Model that integrates over 30 data layers to enhance lunar mapping. This model consolidates decades of lunar observations, facilitating the study of features such as ice, craters, and volcanic activity. The initiative aims to improve planning for future lunar exploration by providing a comprehensive tool for researchers and scientists.

entertainment.title: Horoscope Tomorrow, September 14, 2026: You may finally see the way forward, let clarity guide your next move
entertainment.summary: On September 14, 2026, horoscopes suggest that individuals may gain clarity regarding their future paths. Predictions will be available for all sun signs, offering insights into personal and professional decisions. Kishori Sud, an experienced spiritual practitioner and intuitive guide, provides these forecasts, drawing from her background in tarot reading and holistic healing to assist readers in navigating their journeys.

entertainment.title: The Paradise and AK47: Release Dates Game On!
entertainment.summary: The release date for Venkatesh and Trivikram’s film AK47 remains uncertain. Initially announced for October 2nd in a teaser, the makers have since suggested it may instead be released on October 9th. The situation is further complicated by the simultaneous release of another film, Paradise, which could impact the scheduling of AK47.

entertainment.title: Keerthy Suresh, Kajal Aggarwal and other South Indian stars join 1980s AI photo trend
entertainment.summary: South Indian celebrities, including Keerthy Suresh, Kajal Aggarwal, and Pearle Maaney, have participated in the viral 1980s AI photo trend. Keerthy shared AI-generated images featuring her husband, Antony Thattil, with a caption referencing a parallel universe. Kajal Aggarwal also posted a retro-inspired photo, embracing the nostalgic theme. The trend has gained significant attention among fans and followers.
